lines: All ATK% (공증)
why: Milk must hold ATK #1 so Passion Pay and the captain bonuses land on her, and her buffs scale with her own ATK. Her rank counts pet, perk and captain ATK% too.

lines: A few ATK% lines (up to 4; SR rolls are enough), then crit DMG / Skill AMP and Skill Haste
why: The ATK% puts Rye right behind Milk so she takes Pomegranate's first beam. Skill Haste is confirmed useful.

lines: All Skill AMP
why: She can't receive her own beam; Skill AMP is what raises its value.
disputed: Sugar Pocket's mode-agnostic list only suggests Skill Haste.

lines: All Skill AMP
why: Her ATK buff onto Milk grows with Skill AMP.

lines: All Skill AMP
why: Crit-damage buffer; Skill AMP raises the buff.

lines: Skill AMP, with 1–2 ATK% lines if she has to hold her ATK rank
why: Her crit buff grows with Skill AMP; ATK% only to keep the ATK order (꿀빵 runs 2 ATK + 4 Skill AMP).
disputed: One Arena guide runs Skill AMP + Skill Haste; Rumble posters run ATK% on Macaron to route buffs.

lines: DR, HP, Skill Haste (crit RES optional)
why: Survive the opening and cycle shields faster.
disputed: Sugar Pocket makes HP the priority because her shields scale on her max HP; a commenter on Seo Sinwoo's video says not HP.

lines: DR, HP%, Skill Haste
why: Front tank that has to live through the dive.

lines: DR, HP%, Skill Haste
why: Survival so her healing reduction stays up.
disputed: 올렐레오로리 and Sugar Pocket give her Focus to land the debuff.

lines: Skill Haste, DR, HP; Focus to land the debuff
why: Land the ATK/crit debuff quickly and survive at the front.
disputed: EN commenters run full DR because she kept getting one-shot.

lines: Skill Haste + DR, about 45 Skill Haste total for permanent aura uptime
why: Skill AMP doesn't raise the DR part of Soul Guidance; uptime does.
disputed: Alternatives: ATK so Bari catches Pomegranate's beam, or Skill AMP for the aura damage (community list: Skill AMP, Haste, DR).

lines: Damage lines (ATK% / Skill AMP); 1–2 HP lines at most, DR beyond that
why: Per a leak the aura damage scales on the wrapped cookie's ATK, and the deck loses if it doesn't kill in the opening.
disputed: Rumble builds run Oven fully defensive (see the rumble_arena row).

lines: Skill AMP, crit DMG, DR, ATK%
why: Community consensus list; no measured build posted.

lines: 3–4 Skill Haste lines (about 8 haste from runes), the rest HP / DR / Skill AMP
why: The shield has to come out before Bari's first hit.

lines: Skill AMP, ATK%
why: Her heals scale on ATK.
disputed: The community list says Skill AMP, Haste, DR.

lines: Crit DMG / crit rate / Skill AMP
why: Front damage in the heal-tank variant of the Rye deck.
disputed: Alternatives: Haste 2 / Skill AMP 3 / DR 1; or ATK% + 2 move-speed lines + Haste to take Pomegranate's first beam and nuke the front on turn one.

lines: Skill AMP, Skill Haste, crit DMG, ATK%
why: Only worth it at 5★+.

lines: Skill Haste plus 2–3 evasion lines (the same evasion lines on Ion and Hound)
why: About 1000 team evasion; Focus on gear lands her accuracy-down.

lines: ATK% ×5 + Skill AMP
why: ATK #1 for Passion Pay; the rest of the build is on screen in Seo Sinwoo's Rumble video.

lines: 피감 체력 스증 스가 (DR, HP, Skill AMP, Skill Haste)
why: Given by the then-#1 player when asked for his Bari and Ion runes; no reason stated.
disputed: ATK-heavy if you want Pomegranate's beam on Bari (you must also strip Cherry Cola's ATK); at 5★ posters give up on that.

lines: 피감 체력 스증 스가 (DR, HP, Skill AMP, Skill Haste)
why: Same answer from the then-#1 player; Seo Sinwoo runs Skill Haste, DEF% and DR.

lines: Defensive lines (crit RES, DEF%, HP%); no Skill Haste
why: With haste it runs in alone before the buffs land; the Charge buff and Bari supply the damage.
disputed: Regular-Arena posters give Oven damage lines because the aura damage scales on its ATK.

lines: ATK% (about 3 lines) so Pomegranate's beam lands, then crit DMG and Skill Haste
why: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate routing; Seo Sinwoo's Rye: ATK% 4.7/4.2/4.7, crit DMG 5.8/7.0, Haste +5.
disputed: In the Wizard deck, where Rye is only ATK #4, the author runs Skill AMP > crit DMG > crit rate with no ATK%.

lines: ATK% (공퍼) to route buffs, or all Skill AMP
why: With Pomegranate's beam she holds about 300 crit even under Moon Rabbit.
disputed: Seo Sinwoo runs all Skill AMP; the Rye-deck posters run ATK%.

lines: Skill AMP ×6
why: Beam value.

lines: Skill AMP ×6
why: ATK buff value.

lines: HP% ×6, DR, DEF%
why: Survival; a commenter asks why HP rather than DR.
disputed: Sugar Pocket suggests Focus to land her debuff.

lines: DR ×6, DEF%, HP%
why: Front tank.

lines: Skill Haste ×3 + DR
why: Debuff uptime at the front.

lines: Skill Haste ×4
why: Drone uptime; only at 5★+.

lines: Skill AMP > crit DMG > crit rate (스증 > 치피 > 치확)
why: The carry of the Rapid Fire deck.

lines: Whole team: 스증 스가 피감 회피 (Skill AMP, Skill Haste, DR, evasion); DR instead of crit RES
why: Moon Rabbit makes crit RES less useful than DR; evasion stacked above the enemy's accuracy.
